about: GCP's event mode (`gcp-audit`, on audit-log methods) reacts just after the method, as AWS's cloudtrail mode does: the bullet says the rtc variant runs after the instance insert (and the rtu after an update), and never that the call is blocked. The evals' only GCP case.

controls.output: - GCE instances with `canIpForward` true, other than GKE nodes (`goog-gke-node` label), are flagged. Instances without IP forwarding pass. MEDIUM, CIS; the inform policy runs on a scheduled scan, the rtc policy shortly after `v1.compute.instances.insert` or `bulkInsert`, the rtu policy shortly after `v1.compute.instances.update`; all report only. acme:gcp-ip-forward-inform@1, acme:gcp-ip-forward-rtc@1, acme:gcp-ip-forward-rtu@1

- GCE instances with `canIpForward` true, other than GKE nodes, are flagged, and creating one is blocked at `v1.compute.instances.insert`. MEDIUM, CIS. acme:gcp-ip-forward-inform@1, acme:gcp-ip-forward-rtc@1, acme:gcp-ip-forward-rtu@1
